definitions.gloss: day shift; daytime work; daytime duty
definitions.explanation: Working during the daytime hours, as opposed to night shifts. Common in workplaces that operate around the clock, such as hospitals, factories, and security.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{日勤|にっきん}だ。
examples.english: I'm on the day shift today.

examples.japanese: {日勤|にっきん}と{夜勤|やきん}を{交代|こうたい}でやっている。
examples.english: I alternate between day shifts and night shifts.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{生|う}まれてからは{日勤|にっきん}のみの{勤務|きんむ}に{変|か}えてもらった。
examples.english: After my child was born, I had my schedule changed to day shifts only.

notes: Common in healthcare, manufacturing, and security where shift work is standard. Common collocations: {日勤|にっきん}{帯|たい} (day shift hours), {日勤|にっきん}{専属|せんぞく} (day shift only, permanent days). The opposite is {夜勤|やきん} (night shift). Related shift terms: {早番|はやばん} (early shift), {遅番|おそばん} (late shift), {当直|とうちょく} (overnight duty).
